title: The Garden Gate
tagline: It's the only game where you decide whether to give back what you found.
how_to_play: Arrow keys or WASD to walk, Space to swing, E to talk.

endings.title: The garden, shared
endings.text: Ada walks through the gate beside you. The roses she hasn't seen in weeks are all in bloom.

endings.title: The garden, alone
endings.text: The garden is beautiful. You have it all to yourself. Somewhere behind the wall, Ada is still waiting.
